cards.quote: But it was the mention of her partner, Annie Macgregor Lyle, that caught my attention. The way Bronwen spoke of Annie, with a tenderness and devotion that bordered on reverence, hinted at a love that transcended the boundaries of convention. I imagined Bronwen and Annie strolling through the heather-covered moors, hand in hand, as the sun dipped below the horizon. They would stop at the edge of a tranquil loch, where Annie would recite poetry, her voice carrying on the wind like a gentle melody. Bronwen would listen, entranced, her eyes shining with adoration as she sketched the beauty of their surroundings. As I continued to read, I found myself lost in the world of these two women. I pictured them hosting salons in their Edinburgh townhouse, where they would gather with fellow intellectuals and artists to discuss the latest literary and scientific advancements. Annie, with her quick wit and sharp tongue, would regale the guests with stories of her travels, while Bronwen would charm them with her knowledge of the natural world. The more I read, the more I became convinced that Bronwen and Annie were more than just friends.

raw_card.claim: Bronwen MacDonald Milner is married to Jeremy Neville Stopford.
